list: 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden; 0 online
hidden_source: HowToVideoGame — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the reward for everything else, so there is no separate task to chase. Work through the other 54 trophies in roadmap order and this one pops on its own when the last of them lands. It needs no online play and no DLC, and it is the only platinum in the set. Treat it as your finish line, not a trophy to grind directly, and use the Next-up view to see which single trophy stands between you and it. If one trophy is left, that trophy is your whole job.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 and see it through to its end. It is the first main mission of the game, so you cannot wander past it or skip it. There is nothing extra to collect or do inside it for this trophy; finishing the mission is the whole requirement. It pops as soon as the mission completes, and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every main mission in Chapter 1 and the chapter trophy follows automatically. Chapter 1 is the opening stretch of the story, and its missions arrive in order, so just keep taking the pink main-mission markers. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation at Jason's house described under Positive Mental Attitude, because that one moment may not come back. Once the chapter closes, this trophy is yours and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end and this pops when the chapter closes. The chapter unlocks after Chapter 1, and its main missions are the only thing standing between you and it. Use the chapter to get comfortable with switching between Jason and Lucia, since that unlocks partway through and matters for later partner trophies. There is no side requirement hidden inside the chapter for this trophy, and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 in full and the trophy arrives at the chapter's end. This is the chapter where the map and the crew open up properly, so it is a good time to start scanning new vehicles with WAiNK and trying activities as you pass them. The trophy itself asks for nothing beyond finishing the chapter's main missions in order. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter, as with every chapter, in case you want a way back.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 and this trophy pops when it closes. By now the big robbery systems are coming online, including the bank-vault introduction, so pay attention to new mechanics as they appear rather than rushing past them. The chapter trophy needs only the main missions completed, in order, with no extra objective. It cannot be missed, and the final mission follows in the next chapter.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story and this gold trophy pops. It is the story's last main mission, so reaching it means Chapters 1 to 4 are already done. Before you start it, make a manual save, because there is no mission replay and the post-story free roam is where the long cleanup begins. Finishing it also unlocks the 100% completion checklist, which is the road to the other gold, A Long Road.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2 and finish it. It is a main mission, marked like the others, so it arrives in the natural flow of the chapter and cannot be skipped past. There is no extra condition inside the mission for this trophy; completing it is enough. It pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. It is a main mission, so it comes to you in chapter order and cannot be missed. Treat it as a story beat rather than a grind: show up, play the heist through, and the trophy follows at the end. No side task or collectible is tied to it.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play in Chapter 4. Like the other mission trophies, it unlocks simply by completing that mission when it appears in the chapter's order. There is no medal or hidden objective to worry about, since the game has no mission gold medals. Play it through and the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners in Chapter 4. It is one of the chapter's main missions, so it shows up in the normal order of play and cannot be missed. There is no extra objective to chase inside it for this trophy. Finish the mission and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Play the story mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4 to completion. It is a main mission, so it arrives in chapter order and cannot be skipped. The trophy asks for nothing beyond finishing it. Note the airport setting, because the separate feat trophy Catch Me If You Can also happens at VCIA, but that one is a free-roam stunt, not this mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory, which sits in the final chapter of the game. It is a main mission, so it comes in order and cannot be missed. Finish it and the trophy pops at its end, leaving only the final mission itself. Keep a manual save before it, as you should before every late-story mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Open the 100% completion checklist after the story (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) and work through it line by line. The checklist is forgiving: it is closer to 60% of everything in the game than a true 100%, and most of its lines only need part of a total, such as 15 of 18 card sets or 70 of 80 challenges. Progress you made during the story already counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable, so all of it can be done in post-story free roam. This is the hardest trophy and the bulk of the roughly 200-hour platinum, so treat it as the whole second half of the run rather than a single grind.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts spread across Leonida, mixing the four types however you like. The four types are 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings, and 25 base jumps with a parachute. Under-bridge flights are the quickest to rack up, and the 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going past 250 if you are chasing A Long Road. Track your total under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and find stunt spots on the map under Exploration.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once. The types cover fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race or drone race, and performing a stunt. You can see the list under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities, where scrolling over each type shows how many you have done. Most of them arrive naturally while you work on other trophies, and the map's blue activity icons mark the rest, so this one rarely needs a dedicated session.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges across the two ranges in Leonida. The ranges are Rodgers Ranch in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero, and you can find them on the map under Activities, then Shooting Ranges. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers, and some stay locked until you meet their conditions, which the map shows. Track progress under Touchpad, then Activities, then Shooting Ranges, and retry a challenge as often as needed; a gold in every one is also required for the 100% checklist.
trophies.source: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 drone race locations. Some locations charge an entry fee, so bring cash, and each location is its own win rather than a repeat of the same race. Find the locations on the map under Activities, then Drones, then Top Fun Drones. The 100% checklist needs every drone race too, so the wins here feed straight into A Long Road.
trophies.source: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races, not the same race 20 times. Race locations appear across Leonida as you explore, and you can track them under Touchpad, then Activities, then Racing. Most locations let you hire a car, so check the car's rating before you start, and buy upgrades at mod shops if your own car is falling behind. Spread your wins across new locations and the trophy pops on the twentieth distinct win.
trophies.source: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After you meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, he will text you a fishing challenge, asking for a parrotfish over 2kg, with a purple marker on the map. Take a boat with a fishing rod to the marked area and fish there until you land a parrotfish big enough. You can hijack a boat nearby if you do not own one. Catch the fish Cal asked for and the challenge, and the trophy, are yours.
trophies.source: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of one of the four arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home using the controllers, from Chapter 1 onward, while Bang For Your Buck is found at arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game, not beat every challenge inside it, so pick whichever game suits you best. Home access can be briefly unavailable during some story sections, but it returns after the story.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's optional questline, which is exclusive to Lucia and gets marked automatically in Chapter 3. At some point in Chapter 3, while playing as Lucia, Andy calls you and then texts her home address in Belville, marking the chain on the map. Work through her five quests in order, ending with the final one, and the trophy pops. All of her quests stay available after the story, so there is no rush and nothing here is missable.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's optional questline, which is marked automatically in Chapter 1. A while after the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams, where you work for Kenton, he calls you and is then marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. His quests are treasure-diving runs: he marks purple chest icons on the map, you find the underwater treasure with a metal detector and bring it back to him. Clear his seven shipwrecks across his sets of quests and the final mission, and the trophy, follow. Kenton goes quiet for a stretch after Chapter 1 but returns later in the game, so this is not missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's optional questline, which is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Work through his five quests in order, ending with Hometown Heroes, and the trophy pops. All of his quests remain available after the story, so you can leave this chain until free roam if you prefer. There is nothing missable in it.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers found in the open world, but note that only certain questlines count. Confirmed counting strands include Kirk's Skunk Ape chain, Kyle's farm chain, Yago's street-racing chain, and Pilot Pete's delivery chain, each of which is several missions long. Other optional chains, such as those for Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie, do not count toward this trophy even though they have their own trophies. The game does not yet have a confirmed complete list of every counting strand, so work the confirmed ones first and check the trophy tracker in the trophy list as you go. All stranger strands found so far stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's optional questline, Randy's Wish List, which is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal a Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage, marked with a green RK icon in west Vice City. Scan high-end sports cars with WAiNK to check them against his list, then drive each one back to him; delivering in good condition pays more. His marked cars appear in fixed spots and he marks new ones as you complete them, and the whole chain stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's optional questline, which is only available as Jason and is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers then point to synthetic labs in Vice City; go to them and destroy them as part of the quest to take out the Kitty Litter labs. Once enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives his second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down, and finishing it pops the trophy. The whole chain stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: Potentially missable: the first meditation, Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house, is only available in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth. Do it before Chapter 1 ends and keep a manual save from Chapter 1 until the trophy pops.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida, in 10 locations, and stay until the final zen animation plays, because a spot only counts once that animation finishes. You can meditate with both Jason and Lucia at a spot, which counts twice at the same location, and you can track progress under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation first: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony, and accept when she offers to show you how to meditate. That first meditation raises the counter but is not marked as a normal spot, and it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy strictly needs it, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save. The last spots need both characters together, which unlocks after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Work through Bret Vogel's optional hunting questline, which is exclusive to Jason and is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts you about meeting him in Lummox County. His quests ask you to hunt animals he requests and bring them to him, and his first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. A clean one-shot kill leaves an animal in pristine condition and pays more, but it is not required for the questline. Which exact animal pops this trophy is still being confirmed, so finish the whole chain rather than stopping after one hunt, and track it under Map, then Activities, then Target Deck.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collect every card in 3 complete collectible card sets. There are 18 sets in total, holding 480 cards between them, and each set holds 18 to 36 cards, so pick the smallest sets you can find and finish those first. Track your sets under Progress, then Collections, then Collectible Cards. Cards you collect can be sold at pawn shops and still count toward your progress. The 100% checklist needs 15 full sets, so this trophy arrives naturally on the way to A Long Road if you keep collecting.
trophies.source: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 different locations with the WAiNK app on your phone, holding Up to open it and scanning while on foot. Scannable things include 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus other tags, and there are more than 100 in total, so any 100 will do. You get an on-screen prompt when a scannable location is nearby. Check your count under Touchpad, then Progress, then Collections, then WAiNK Locations, and keep scanning as you travel, since this also feeds the 100% checklist.
trophies.source: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges in the game. Challenges are in-game feats across combat, exploration, vehicles, survival and more, and you can view them all under Touchpad, then Progress, then Challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this trophy pops on the way there if you are chasing A Long Road. Most challenges fill up naturally while you work on other trophies, so leave this one late, then pick the easiest remaining challenges to finish it off.
trophies.source: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then escape the red heat zone completely. You can only do this after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam together and call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Cause enough trouble to reach 4 stars, then break away on a fast sports motorcycle, cutting through traffic, and shoot at any helicopter chasing you. A reliable escape route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where police struggle to follow and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy pops once you drive out of the red heat zone, and it also comes naturally while robbing bank vaults later.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row while keeping your wanted level the whole time, never letting it drop. This is only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Hit robbery targets marked with green icons, loot a couple of items in each shop, and ideally break the safe in the back room with sticky bombs. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, unlocked after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the third shop, and if it does not fire, hit a fourth shop and keep going.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles, which you can do just by scanning them with WAiNK, without driving them. Open WAiNK on your phone, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it, and stand on a busy road to scan traffic as it passes. There are 557 vehicles at launch, including cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes, so scan boats and aircraft too when you see them. Check your totals under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles. The 100% checklist wants 200 base-model vehicles scanned, so this trophy arrives on the way there.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 plus R3 while aiming a firearm, which slows time and highlights vulnerable spots, and it drains the purple focus bar under your health and stamina. Before you try, raise your focus by eating, drinking, washing up at home, or taking Adrenaline to stretch the slow-time window, and wear body armor from Ammu-Nation so you can step out of cover. Line up 5 enemies at a gang operation, use an accurate full-auto rifle such as the Duke 556, and drop them quickly without missing. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, and it gets easier as your focus level rises through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane that is docked to a departure terminal at VCIA, the Vice City International Airport, and fly it away. It has to be a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not one parked out on the airfield. The easiest is the plane at departure terminals E3 and E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, and use the stairs by the boarding bridge to get inside, then go upstairs to the cockpit. Drive the plane backward to the runway, take off, and fly at least 1km away from the airport; the trophy pops a little after you are clear.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank, a Rhino, and take out enemies from inside it. The tanks stand at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate, or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, then climb into a tank and start shooting enemies until the trophy pops. Expect heavy resistance on the base, so go in ready for a fight and do not stop to loot on the way out.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected, which needs the Snap Gun first. Finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun and jewelry store robberies, which are then marked with green icons on unfogged parts of the map. Break in through the back door using the Snap Gun instead of kicking the door, which would trip the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. A good target is Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City, and the trophy pops shortly after you leave the store.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, which introduces bank vault robberies: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then a guard carries a briefcase of cash inside and opens the vault, and you slip in while it is open, bringing your partner to carry a second bag. After that, pay Yasmani for tips about security vans, at $10,000 a tip, and follow the purple-marked vans to more banks. Each vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. There are 8 large bank jobs in total, and the 100% checklist needs all 8, so this silver pops on the way.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the red heat radius afterwards. The simplest route is the same Chapter 4 mission that unlocks bank vaults, That's Where The Money Is, where tailing the armored truck to a bank and robbing its vault counts as robbing an armored truck. You can also do it earlier in free roam: find an armored truck driving near banks in Vice City, block its path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open. Sticky bombs are available in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests. Either way, the trophy only pops once you have escaped the heat, so use a Pay 'n' Spray or a fast getaway if the police close in.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida, revealing every area. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every patch of black fog on the map until the entire state is visible. Do it after the story, when you can travel freely, and combine it with WAiNK scanning and stunt runs, since you will be crossing the same regions anyway. There is no count to chase beyond the fog itself, and the trophy pops when the last dark patch clears.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs in Leonida. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total, marked with yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are also marked automatically as the story progresses. You can track each gang's count under Progress, then Gangs, where scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed. The 100% checklist needs all 39 operations, so this trophy pops early on the way to A Long Road.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach and buy an Apple Martini. Drink it while standing next to the bar, with the view in front of you, and the trophy pops. There is no mission or unlock needed first, so you can do this whenever you are in the area. It is a small moment, so do it on a visit to the beach rather than making a special trip late in the run.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You can only do this after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, since you need it to hack into the car. Get in the Banshee, drive forward through the glass, and keep driving down the street; the trophy pops a little after you are outside. It only works with that specific blue Banshee, not with any other car in the showroom.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations run by Kolt & Associates. Buy sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation first, because you need them to blow open the safe. Inside the alley, pick up the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and loot the safe in the office in the north-east hallway. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. You first visit during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, but you do not need all 3 in one go: the robbery icon respawns after a long time, so you can return later for anything you missed.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. This is only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Raise strength by working out, with a membership at a fitness club, and always bring your partner along by holding Right and pressing Triangle to call them. While one character works out, the other trains automatically, so you make double progress. Check each character's strength under Touchpad, then Jason and Lucia, then the Strength entry with the heart icon. Fitness clubs are marked on the map under Activities, and you can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile, which PlayStation tracks as a count to 500. You can see your progress by clicking the trophy in the trophy list, and it helps to turn on criminal profile notifications in Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, so a small demon face appears whenever an action counts. Robberies, stealthy objectives, destroying evidence and clean escapes push you toward Professional; wounding without killing pushes Hardened; killing pushes Violent, and large-scale killing pushes Psycho. Most of the 500 fill up passively while you work on other trophies and the 100% checklist, so do not farm it early. If it is still short at the end, keep doing robberies and enemy encounters rather than grinding one action.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No launch-era guide has confirmed how this trophy triggers. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, with a belief that it is related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, but that is not a confirmed method. The official description, Second time's the charm, suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something, yet no source has pinned down which attempt or where. Do not chase a specific invented step for this one; play the game normally, keep an eye on updated guides, and treat any method that cites no source as a guess. This entry will be updated when a launch-era source confirms the trigger.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg on the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2am, going alone. The event is slightly random and not a guaranteed spawn: sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside, and if it is not there, drive away and come back later. When the car is there, follow the path from it into the woods and you will see the UFO, a bright blue light in the sky. Approach it and the UFO drops a woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, and when she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside, do it, and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No launch-era guide has confirmed how this trophy triggers. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, with a belief that it comes from kicking people while driving a motorcycle, but that is not a confirmed method. The official description, Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by, points at knocking someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, yet no source has pinned down the exact vehicle, weapon or target. Do not chase a specific invented step for this one; try melee drive-bys in normal play, watch updated guides, and treat any method that cites no source as a guess.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts, which counts across many robberies rather than in one haul. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, where you meet Raul's crew, to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer that lets you launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans, and bring the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. Bank vaults alone can give up to $205,000 in a single robbery, once they unlock after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is, so this total fills naturally while you do the robberies for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops in the game. The fastest way is to buy the expensive things: guns at Ammu-Nation, car mods at mod shops, and tattoos are the priciest, but clothing, footwear, hair and beauty, and electronics all count too. There is no single purchase that has to be made, and the total is cumulative across the whole run, so it fills up naturally if you keep your gear and cars upgraded. If it is still short late in the run, spend the difference on mods or weapons you actually want.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone, for a total of $160,000. Garages become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when you steal the Crawler for Moses, and the app is installed on your phone then. The eight are Mitchel Auto Center at $4,000, 7th Avenue Garage at $12,000, Vela Rota Drive Garage at $24,000, Persistence Road Garage at $7,600, Wyatt Motors at $21,600, Bonita Court Garage at $34,000, Atlantic Court Garage at $40,000, and Store n' Bolt at $16,800. Each adds one parking spot, which also feeds the vehicle registration trophy. Story garages do not count; only these eight purchasable ones do.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 different vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, which is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission where you take a vehicle to Moses. Scooter Bros delivers a registered vehicle to your location, and registration needs a free parking spot, so buy garages first under Little Boxes, since each garage adds spots. Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, and in his garage choose Respray and then Register. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers, and later, from Chapter 3, you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the bill down.
